answer: Sybil resistance is rent plus maintenance. Each agent posts collateral at entry, and its standing must be re-forged continuously: peers run zephyr audits — small, random challenges a genuine participant answers cheaply — and every failure slashes the stake behind that account. A fake identity thus needs its own deposit plus constant passing work, so growing an attack grows its cost. The economy becomes a lagoon: a reef of deposits admits only funded, verified vessels, while honest reputations, forged from steady validated work, compound.
